author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam meets FBFX's head of paint Anadora Peralta to learn her process for painting sci-fi blaster damage on costume armor! It's Adam's first exposure to airbrushing Copic alcohol inks, and the paint effect on chrome armor is stunning!

Learn more about FBFX’s work at https://www.fbfx.co.uk/
Adam Savage Learns How to Battle Damage Costume Armor: https://youtu.be/nKwgOO24jTI
Darth Vader's Battle-Damaged Helmet from Obi-Wan Kenobi: https://youtu.be/vUzd50rxlF4
Breastplate Armor With a Cannonball Hole: https://youtu.be/vD6bCGXzuJs

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
